hero.title_part1: We build your web & AI products.
hero.title_part2: And we craft our own games.
hero.description: No sales fluff or generic templates. At BKN Tech, we are passionate engineers and creators: we build elite web & mobile platforms, integrate truly useful AI agents into your operations, and develop our own cooperative game.

about.title: Hands-on engineers, not smooth talkers.
about.description: BKN Tech combines a rare dual expertise: bespoke B2B software engineering and complex system architecture (Unity netcode, autonomous AI agents, cloud infrastructure). We champion clean code, clarity, and real business impact.

tech.title: Technical Excellence
tech.desc: Strictly typed code, maintainable architecture (SOLID), and millisecond-level optimization.

roi.title: Value & ROI Focus
roi.desc: No bloated bloatware or vanity features. Every single line of code solves a practical problem.

craft.title: Build Culture
craft.desc: We don't just advise: we design, test, and stress-test our own tech stacks daily.

services_home.title: What We Build For You
services_home.subtitle: From high-conversion showcase sites to self-hosted sovereign AI agents.

web.title: Web Apps & Fullstack Platforms
web.desc: High-impact landing pages, SEO-optimized showcase sites, and responsive web applications (Next.js, Node.js, Supabase, Stripe). Customer portals, dashboards, and automated workflows.

mobile.title: iOS & Android Engineering
mobile.desc: Fluid mobile apps engineered with React Native or Flutter. Strict adherence to platform guidelines (Human Interface & Material Design) and hardware integration.
features: App Store / Play Store Publishing & Compliance

ai.title: Business AI Agents & Private LLMs
ai.desc: Deployment of 24/7 RAG agents plugged into your internal knowledge base, automated document processing (OCR), and zero-data-leak private AI models.

game_home.title: On the side: Vacuum Protocol
game_home.subtitle: A cooperative multiplayer game crafted in-house.
game_home.desc: Alongside our B2B engineering services, we design Vacuum Protocol: a 4-player co-op action game built with Unity. Command ghost-vacuuming robots in a quirky universe with retro PSX cartoon aesthetics.
game_home.netcode_desc: Authoritative Mirror Networking with real-time prediction and state sync.
game_home.graphics_desc: Nostalgic retro aesthetics featuring PSX vertex snapping and vibrant textures.

footer.description: Custom platform engineering & multiplayer game development. Technical and aesthetic excellence.

devlog.description: An indie game developed solo. Vacuum Protocol is a 4-player online co-op game where you pilot ghost-cleaning robots. Blending humor, PSX cartoon aesthetics and team cohesion — a one-of-a-kind experience coming to Steam Early Access.
devlog.discord_cta: Join the Discord to take part in upcoming playtests and try future demos!

netcode.title: Online Multiplayer
netcode.desc: Up to 4 players in co-op via Mirror Networking on Unity URP. Authoritative server architecture with real-time synchronization of positions, player actions and ghost states.

physics.title: PSX Cartoon Aesthetic
physics.desc: Intentionally retro art direction: PSX vertex snapping, low-resolution textures, saturated color palette. A quirky cartoon style that reinforces the humor and the absurd universe of the game.

graphics.title: Steam — Early Access
graphics.desc: Vacuum Protocol will launch in Early Access on Steam within the next year. Join the Discord now to get in on private playtests and help shape the game with us.

privacy.sec1_body: The person responsible for processing the personal data collected on this site is:
privacy.sec1_contact: For any question relating to the protection of your data, you can contact us by email:
privacy.sec2_body: We only collect data sent voluntarily via our contact form:
privacy.sec2_purpose: Purpose & Legal basis: Respond to your inquiries and establish commercial proposals (Legitimate interest / Pre-contractual measures - Art. 6.1 GDPR).
privacy.sec3_li1: Information requests: 3 years maximum from the last contact from you.
privacy.sec3_li2: Business relationships: For the duration of the contractual relationship, then 5 to 10 years according to legal accounting and tax obligations.
privacy.sec4_body: Your data is strictly intended for Bkn Tech team members. No resale or transfer to third parties.
privacy.sec4_sub: Our hosting and email routing infrastructures are operated by OVHcloud SAS on secure servers located exclusively in France / European Union.
privacy.sec5_body: This site does not use any advertising targeting cookies or third-party trackers for behavioral analysis purposes (e.g. Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel). We only use technical local storage strictly necessary for the operation of the interface (e.g. remembering your preferred language FR/EN via i18nextLng). In accordance with CNIL guidelines, these technical elements are exempt from prior consent.
privacy.sec6_body: In accordance with European regulations (GDPR EU 2016/679) and the French Data Protection Act, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy.sec6_card1_desc: Consult or have your personal data corrected at any time.
privacy.sec6_card2_desc: Request the permanent deletion of your personal data.
privacy.sec6_card3_desc: Restrict or oppose the processing of your data.
privacy.sec6_card4_desc: Receive your data in a structured and readable format.
privacy.sec6_footer1: To exercise any of these rights, contact us by email at:
privacy.sec6_footer2: If you feel after contacting us that your rights are not respected, you can submit a complaint to the CNIL (Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés) on their website
